idea-plugin.name: Merge Hell Runner
idea-plugin.description:
The build is red. The deadline is tonight. Your only escape is to run.

Merge Hell Runner is a full-blown, side-scrolling action game that lives inside your IntelliJ IDEA tool window. Stop fixing merge conflicts — outrun them. Turn every NullPointerException, every 3am on-call page, and every 800-line legacy class into a boss you can finally shoot back at.


🔥 Escape the Merge Hell 🔥

A complete 5-level campaign of industrial ruins, suspended construction, geothermal warfare, and an alien infestation — playable in the time it takes your CI pipeline to fail again.


🚀 What's inside v1.0.0:

  • 🗺️ 5 Distinct Missions: Run from Repository City to the Heap District, Aerial Citadel, Geothermal Foundry, and the reality-bending Alien Hive.
  • 👹 5 Unique Bosses: Break the dependency graph of the Legacy Code Monstrosity, then face the Memory Leak Daemon, Aerial Gantry Architect, Geothermal Siege Engine, and the adaptive Alien Rootheart.
  • 🧬 Level-Specific Enemies: Fight heap leaks, rail sentinels, shield wardens, cable wasps, welding drones, thermal drillers, slag crawlers, resin spitters, spore drifters, and alien pouncers.
  • 🌊 Arena Battle Zones: Clear authored squads of chapter-specific enemies while navigating suspended platforms, foundry machinery and living defenses.
  • 🔫 6-Weapon Arsenal: Blast bugs with git push, spread-fire git push -f, rapid git commit -a, the devastating rm -rf /, flaming git blaze, and the screen-clearing sudo rm -rf / laser.
  • ⚡ Sudo Overclock & Defense: Kills and reflections charge a brief boosted barrage. Shield pickups grant temporary damage immunity; Shield Reboot can prevent a fatal hit, and health drops restore HP.
  • 🪙 Coins & Local Leaderboard: Collect coins mid-run and chase your Top 5 high scores, saved right in your IDE.
  • 🏃 Tight Platforming: Double-jump, dash through danger with i-frames, and rack up a combo multiplier for style points.
  • 🎨 Illustrated worlds: Volumetric 2D characters, dedicated painted panoramas, articulated mechanical and alien bosses, breakable scenery, moving lifts, conveyors and hazardous terrain.
  • 🔇 IDE-friendly: Muted by default, optional music and sound, unified English and Simplified Chinese, pause and safe-segment checkpoints.

"The only plugin where rm -rf / is a valid survival strategy."


Crafted with ❤️, ☕ and a lot of git merge --abort by Phil Zhang.
Check out my portfolio: phil-the-guy.netlify.app
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.0 — Combat & Exploration Expansion

  • NEW: Eight-way aiming, grounded crouch fire and stationary aim with matching articulated poses for every weapon.
  • NEW: Four independent operatives, including a hidden Night-shift Engineer discovered in the first chapter.
  • NEW: Relaxed, Standard and Challenge profiles with separate rankings, tougher enemies and faster Boss attack combinations.
  • NEW: Longer routes across all five chapters, solid jump obstacles, crawl passages, upper facilities and optional secrets.
  • NEW: Safe-segment saves preserve resources, route changes and discoveries while existing entrance saves remain compatible.
  • IMPROVED: Illustrated route materials, a bilingual F1 controls guide and a one-second bomb cooldown. Audio is still muted by default.

Illustrated Campaign Overhaul

Merge Hell Runner is now a complete five-mission campaign with a distinct world, enemy ecosystem, and boss encounter for every chapter.

  • NEW: Five visually distinct missions: Repository City, Heap District, Aerial Citadel, Geothermal Foundry, and Alien Hive.
  • NEW: Five handcrafted bosses with unique phase rules, attacks, silhouettes, and encounter HUDs.
  • NEW: Nine exclusive later-chapter enemy families with distinct movement, armor, attack warnings and projectile patterns.
  • NEW: Authored arena squads, working elevators and counterweights, conveyors and coolant, breakable membranes and hatching nests.
  • NEW: Six-weapon arsenal, including the Flame and Laser weapons.
  • NEW: Coin collection and a persistent local Top-5 leaderboard.
  • NEW: Platforming layer with dash i-frames, double jump, and combo multipliers.
  • FIXED: Cleared arenas no longer restart, Lab boss shortcuts work in every mission, and mission-complete screens remain readable before the next level begins.
